# Agent ShipKit (agent-shipkit)

> Full-stack indie monetization engineering pack (6 production `SKILL.md` modules + executable zero-dependency Node.js CLI scripts) built for Claude Code, Cursor, and Google Antigravity.

## Included Skills
1. **geo-llms-auditor (Free Starter)**: Website AI citation audit (0-100 score) + automatic `llms.txt` and Schema.org JSON-LD generator (`audit-geo.mjs`).
2. **appstore-pain-miner (Pro)**: Apple iTunes Search & Customer Reviews RSS 1-3 star complaint miner + one-time buyout pricing anchor calculator (`mine-appstore.mjs`).
3. **zero-server-ed25519-paywall (Pro)**: Offline Ed25519 `OPC1.<payload>.<sig>` license keypair generator, token issuer, and Node/WebCrypto paywall scaffolder (`paywall-kit.mjs`).
4. **runaway-token-guard (Pro)**: AI coding session JSONL log analyzer, retry-loop detector, and USD budget circuit breaker (`token-guard.mjs`).
5. **sunk-cost-cro-landing (Pro)**: Bilingual "Interactive-Tool-First" high-conversion static landing page generator (`scaffold-landing.mjs`).
6. **cold-start-launch-pack (Pro)**: Authentic Show HN, Reddit, Product Hunt, and V2EX launch copy + UTM link matrix generator (`generate-launch-pack.mjs`).
